definitions.explanation: A product that emits pleasant scents to freshen indoor air.

examples.japanese: ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{芳香剤|ほうこうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I have an air freshener in the bathroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{芳香剤|ほうこうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put an air freshener in my car.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{芳香剤|ほうこうざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ラベンダー→ラベンダー：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This air freshener has a lavender scent.

notes:
{芳香剤|ほうこうざい} is an air freshener — a product that adds a pleasant smell to a room, a car or a toilet. Formation: ⟦{芳香|ほうこう}→芳香：13960_houkou⟧ 'fragrance' + {剤|ざい} 'agent'.

Forms:
- ⟦{置|お}き→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧: the standing gel or liquid pot, left on a shelf or cistern
- ⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：noentry⟧: spray
- ⟦{吊|つ}り{下|さ}げ→吊り下げる：20298_tsurisageru⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧: the hanging kind, typical in cars

Collocations:
- {芳香剤|ほうこうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put out an air freshener
- {芳香剤|ほうこうざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: the scent of an air freshener

The distinction Japanese products insist on is between adding a scent and removing a smell. A ⟦{消臭剤|しょうしゅうざい}→消臭剤：07088_shoushuuzai⟧ neutralises odours and may be unscented; a {芳香剤|ほうこうざい} covers them with a fragrance. Many products now claim to do both.
